aitable.query_records.review_reason: The reviewed query command supports both an optional ID lookup mode and a table scan/filter mode, so --record-ids is not unconditionally required.

aitable.view_update_aggregate.review_reason: The reviewed CLI accepts --json, a --field-id/--action pair, or --clear-field-id; the registered typed constraints describe those alternatives.

aitable.view_update_card.review_reason: The reviewed CLI merges optional typed card flags over an optional --json block; the registered typed constraints require at least one real update field.

aitable.view_update_field_widths.review_reason: The reviewed CLI accepts either --json or the paired --field-id/--width form, which is represented by typed require-one-of and require-together constraints.

aitable.view_update_timebar.review_reason: The reviewed CLI accepts either a complete --json block or one or more typed Gantt timebar fields; --json is therefore not unconditionally required.

aitable.workflow_create.review_reason: The command maps --base-id and a decoded workflow-dsl/v1 --dsl object to aitable/create_workflow. The call intentionally bypasses retries because creation is non-idempotent; locale remains optional.

aitable.workflow_update.review_reason: The command maps --base-id, --workflow-id and a decoded complete workflow-dsl/v1 --dsl object to aitable/update_workflow. This is full replacement rather than a partial patch; locale remains optional.
